data.name: Ifraaza
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'ifra' which means to be exalted, raised, elevated, or to become free from something. In Islamic context, it is used to describe the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) being taken up to the heavens after his death. It also symbolizes spiritual growth and elevation in one's faith.
